future formal project and R&D master-data modules

interfaces.name: Release REST API
interfaces.invariant: Server owns validation, authority and persisted business state.

interfaces.name: WorkflowBusinessGateway
interfaces.invariant: Release starts or terminates workflows by public contract and never writes workflow tables.

interfaces.name: WorkflowLifecycleConsumer
interfaces.invariant: Only release_application events for the active round change release state.

interfaces.name: AttachmentGateway
interfaces.invariant: Attachment tenant, owner, status and binding are validated by the platform contract.

interfaces.name: Selector snapshot DTO
interfaces.invariant: Only selector options are Mock; submitted ID, code, name and artifact type become persistent snapshots.

disturbances.effect: Same-file edits may change composition or prototype assumptions

disturbances.source: Unpublished or differently configured workflow definitions
disturbances.effect: Submission fails or approval path differs

disturbances.source: Duplicate, delayed or stale workflow events
disturbances.effect: Potential repeated or out-of-order release transitions
Upload or preview fails independently of release state

delays.consequence: Approval API may complete before release state is visible
delays.sampling_rule: Poll the business detail until the persisted lifecycle event is consumed or timeout explicitly.

delays.consequence: Immediate stale display can be mistaken for failed persistence
delays.sampling_rule: Sample after the command response and authoritative refetch finish.

delays.consequence: A temporary attachment can expire before application submission
delays.sampling_rule: Verify TEMP then BOUND states within one acceptance flow.

delays.consequence: Large filters can delay summary and drill-down
delays.sampling_rule: Compare results only after both requests complete under identical filters.

assumptions.text: JdbcTemplate remains the repository persistence pattern.
assumptions.evidence: System, workflow and attachment services use JdbcTemplate and baseline tests pass.
assumptions.falsifier: Release module cannot implement transactional queries without a new persistence dependency.

assumptions.text: WorkflowBusinessGateway and AttachmentGateway are stable public contracts.
assumptions.evidence: Interfaces exist in declared public packages and their module tests pass.
assumptions.falsifier: Release contract tests require platform-private data or signature changes.

assumptions.text: The existing prototype visual structure can be retained while changing its data source.
assumptions.evidence: Release views and responsive CSS already exist and frontend baseline build passes.
assumptions.falsifier: Formal DTOs require a page structure incompatible with approved workflows.
